body.name: Universal identity-optimal tensor cone
body.construction: \[\mathcal C_{N,K}(H)=\left\{\Omega\in\mathbb R^{K\times K\times N\times N}:\mathscr L_{H,\Omega}(x,\mathrm{id})\geq\mathscr L_{H,\Omega}(x,\sigma)\text{ for every }x\in\mathcal M_N^K\text{ and }\sigma\in\mathfrak S_N^K\right\}.\] It is a closed convex cone because every defining comparison is homogeneous and linear in \(\Omega\).
